description: Calculate k-mer based distance between two sequences using Euclidean distance of k-mer frequencies (default). Optional metric, same values and library overload as the Analysis server's kmer_distance: squared_euclidean_counts, manhattan, chebyshev, canberra, cosine, d2 (a similarity), d2star / d2shepherd (background-adjusted d2* / d2S dissimilarities in [0,1], Reinert et al. 2009; Song et al. 2014; Markov background of order markovOrder fitted to each sequence, ACGT words, k <= 12). bothStrands = CAFE -R both-strand d2*/d2S. jensen_shannon: JS divergence (base 2) of the frequency vectors; euclidean_counts: Euclidean distance of raw counts.

markovOrder.description: Background Markov order r (0 <= r < k) for d2star/d2shepherd, or -1 to choose each sequence's order by BIC; must be 0 for the other metrics

bothStrands.description: d2star/d2shepherd only: CAFE -R both-strand mode (count of w + count of its reverse complement; background probability averaged over w and its reverse complement)

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
metric must be one of: euclidean, squared_euclidean_counts, manhattan, chebyshev, canberra, cosine, d2, d2star, d2shepherd, jensen_shannon, euclidean_counts
markovOrder applies only to the background-adjusted metrics D2Star and D2Shepherd.
bothStrands applies only to the background-adjusted metrics D2Star and D2Shepherd; count canonical k-mers (KmerCountingOptions.Canonical) for the other metrics.
